description: This file contains utility functions for interacting with Git repositories, including retrieving repository info, converting URLs, checking repository status, and performing various Git operations such as searching commits, getting diffs, and checking branch status.

methods.name: getGitRepositoryInfo
methods.description: Extracts git repository information such as URL, name, and default branch from the .git directory of the given workspace root.

methods.name: convertGitUrlToHttps
methods.description: Converts various git URL formats to HTTPS format for telemetry and standardization.

methods.name: sanitizeGitUrl
methods.description: Removes sensitive information like tokens from a git URL.

methods.name: extractRepositoryName
methods.description: Extracts the repository name from a git URL.

methods.name: getWorkspaceGitInfo
methods.description: Retrieves git repository info for the current VSCode workspace.

methods.name: searchCommits
methods.description: Searches for commits matching a query in the specified repository directory.

methods.name: getCommitInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific commit, including diff and stats.

methods.name: getWorkingState
methods.description: Gets the current working state of the repository, including uncommitted changes.

methods.name: getGitStatus
methods.description: Provides a summary of the current git status with optional file limit.

methods.name: getCurrentBranch
methods.description: Returns the current branch name of the repository.

methods.name: detectBaseBranch
methods.description: Detects the default base branch (main/master/develop) from remote or local branches.

methods.name: hasUncommittedChanges
methods.description: Checks if there are uncommitted changes in the repository.

methods.name: getUncommittedDiff
methods.description: Gets the diff of all uncommitted changes.

methods.name: getUncommittedFiles
methods.description: Lists files with uncommitted changes and their statuses.

methods.name: resolveBranchRef
methods.description: Resolves a branch name to an existing local or remote ref.

methods.name: getBranchDiff
methods.description: Gets the diff between the current branch and a specified base branch.

methods.name: getBranchFilesChanged
methods.description: Lists files changed between the current branch and a specified base branch.

methods.name: isOnBaseBranch
methods.description: Checks if the current branch is a recognized base branch.

methods.name: getCommitCountFromBase
methods.description: Counts the number of commits ahead of a specified base branch.
